description: Before arrival, the crew must prepare a coherent document bundle for port entry, inspection readiness, declarations, and likely follow-up questions from authorities. All ports and vessel names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 38-year-old shipboard administrator responsible for arrival paperwork under tight timing
user_profile.context: The documents exist, but they are spread across different preparation streams and must be made inspection-ready before arrival
user_profile.communication_style: Administrative and orderly, wants the bundle assembled by purpose rather than source

fact_sheet.fact: The vessel's name is the MV 'Stellar Compass'.
The IMO Number for the MV 'Stellar Compass' is 9876543.
The current voyage number is SC-2024-07A.
The last port of call was the Port of Aethel.
The Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) at Port of Meridian is July 28, 2024, at 06:00 local time.
The destination port is the Port of Meridian.
The governing body for the port is the Meridian Harbor Authority (MHA).
The assigned berth for the MV 'Stellar Compass' is Terminal 7, Berth 4.
The appointed port agent is Meridian Maritime Services.
The MHA Port Operations Officer for this arrival is Mr. Jian Li.
The shipboard administrator responsible for paperwork is Elena Petrova.
The Master of the MV 'Stellar Compass' is Captain Aarav Sharma.
The Chief Officer, Sofia Rossi, is responsible for verifying the Cargo Declaration.
The primary email contact for the agent, Meridian Maritime Services, is ops@meridianmaritime.com.
The direct phone line for the agent's operations desk is +1-555-234-5678.
The ship's official document management system is 'SeaDocs Pro' version 4.2.
The login URL for SeaDocs Pro is https://seadocs.horizonshipping.co/login.
All official declarations must be submitted electronically via the Meridian Harbor Authority's 'SafeHarbor' portal.
The URL for the SafeHarbor portal is https://safeharbor.portofmeridian.gov.
The ship's crew uses the Slack channel #SC-2024-07A-Meridian for real-time coordination with the port agent.
The arrival bundle must include the IMO General Declaration (FAL Form 1).
The Crew List (FAL Form 5) must list all 22 crew members currently on board.
The Cargo Declaration (FAL Form 2) must detail the 15,450 metric tons of bulk grain on board.
The Ship's Stores Declaration (FAL Form 3) is a required component of the document bundle.
The Crew's Effects Declaration (FAL Form 4) is required for all non-domiciled crew.
A completed Maritime Declaration of Health must be submitted, signed by the Master within 24 hours of submission.
The Ballast Water Reporting Form must indicate a mid-ocean exchange was performed on July 22, 2024.
A valid copy of the International Ship Security Certificate (ISSC), expiring on December 31, 2025, must be included.
The Port of Meridian requires 3 printed copies of the Crew List for the on-arrival inspection.
The deadline for submitting the full document bundle to the SafeHarbor portal is July 27, 2024, at 06:00 local time.
The final submission must be a single, collated PDF file, not exceeding 25 MB in size.
The required PDF filename format is 'IMO9876543_VoyageSC-2024-07A_ArrivalDocs.pdf'.
The Master's office (Cabin A-01) must have the physical document bundle printed and ready for inspection upon the pilot's boarding.
All crew passports and seaman's books must be collected and arranged in the order they appear on the Crew List (FAL Form 5) by 04:00 on the day of arrival.
